source.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent full-body NPC illustration for the Chinese grounded survival strategy game 《电梯求生》.
Primary request: Zhou Heng (周衡), an ordinary middle-aged survivor in the logistics rest room. This is only a visual appearance candidate, not a new profession, power, relationship or biography. A middle-aged man with short slightly greying dark hair, natural weathered face and faint stubble, tired but clear eyes. Faded old slate-blue / grey-blue work shirt-jacket over a plain muted dark undershirt, ordinary charcoal-brown trousers, plain dark worn shoes. Practical civilian work clothing, no uniform insignia or markings. Average solid build, not a bulky infected porter and not a gaunt infected technician.
Pose and expression: a complete full-body three-quarter standing portrait, turned very slightly toward screen left and calmly looking toward an interlocutor near camera. Both feet stably planted, modest relaxed stance, shoulders a little tired but upright. BOTH HANDS EMPTY and fully visible, one loosely at the side and one resting naturally near the hip without gripping an object. A reserved, alert, steady human survivor; not aggressive, frightened, infected or in a combat stance.
Distinct silhouette: short practical shirt-jacket rather than Lin Cen's long brown-grey coat; older male face, no tied hair, no medical outfit, no reflective safety vest, no deep-teal one-piece coveralls, no tool belt. No weapon, pipe, firearm, handheld item, paperwork, nameplate, insignia, badge, backpack, armour or strange device. No injuries, blood, unhealthy veins, lesions, glowing eyes or supernatural effects.
Style: cold dark realistic cinematic game artwork, grounded painted photorealism, careful visible cloth texture, realistic folds, hair, skin, hands and shoes, restrained saturation. Same material clarity as the inspected 05-combat reference and previous standalone characters, but obviously a living ordinary survivor. Cool soft overall illumination with a faint neutral warm side light on the face to maintain readability, no strong glow.
Composition: request native 1536 × 1920 pixels, portrait 4:5 PNG, full entire head, both hands, legs and shoes visible. Clear generous transparent margins above the hair and below both shoes. Head near normalized y=0.08, feet near y=0.92; approximate foot-ground midpoint (0.50,0.92). Figure occupies about 84% of image height, centred body with no clipped extremities. Preserve the full untrimmed transparent canvas.
Background: TRUE transparent alpha. No room, furniture, chair, floor, cast shadow blob, haze, particles, vignette, checkerboard, solid backdrop, border or frame.
Text: none. No writing, UI, labels, logo, watermark or nameplate. Deliver exactly ONE full-body Zhou Heng character sprite.
